channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Bangladesh Students’ League urges neutral administration for inclusive 2026 elections
item.description: The student organization said in the aftermath of the fall of the Hasina-led Awami League government, what followed was the systematic replacement of constitutional governance with mob rule—"organized violence, fear and impunity.

item.title: Shilpa Shetty remembers her dad on his birthday: ‘Hope you are enjoying your single malt up there’
item.description: Actress Shilpa Shetty remembered her late dad, Surendra Shetty, who would have turned 85 years old on Monday, with a heartwarming social media post.

item.title: Bus accident kills 15, injures 19 in Indonesia’s Semarang city
item.description: Fifteen people were killed and 19 others injured in the early hours of Monday in a bus accident at the intersection of the Krapyak toll exit in Semarang city, Indonesia's Central Java province, local authorities reported.

item.title: Sonia Gandhi accuses Centre of bulldozing MGNREGA, warns of ‘catastrophic fallout’
item.description: In an article published in a leading national daily, Sonia Gandhi argued that MGNREGA, enacted in 2005 under the UPA as a rights-based legislation guaranteeing the constitutional right to work, was being effectively dismantled "without discussion, consultation or respect for parliamentary processes."

item.title: Was nervous before national anthem but happy to execute my plan: Vaishnavi Sharma
item.description: India’s young spinner Vaishnavi Sharma is keen to build on a promising start to her international career and establish herself as a regular in the team’s white-ball plans.

item.title: Delhi pollution: Air quality remains in ‘very poor’ category, smog persists
item.description: The national capital continued to reel under heavy smog on Monday morning, with air quality levels remaining in the “very poor” category and several areas slipping into “severe” pollution levels.

item.title: Four family members charred to death in house fire in Bengal’s Uluberia
item.description: Four members of a family were charred to death after a fire broke out at their house in Uluberia in West Bengal’s Howrah district, police said on Monday. The tragic incident occurred late Sunday night while the victims were fast asleep.

item.title: India-New Zealand FTA: PM Modi, Luxon aim to double bilateral trade over 5 years
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi held a telephone conversation with New Zealand's Prime Minister, Christopher Luxon, on Monday as the two leaders jointly announced the successful conclusion of the historic, ambitious and mutually beneficial India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement (FTA).

item.title: India, New Zealand seal historic FTA; tariffs on 95 pc Kiwi goods reduced
item.description: New Zealand and India have concluded a Free Trade Agreement (FTA), offering New Zealanders unprecedented access to 1.4 billion Indian consumers, Trade and Investment Minister Todd McClay announced on Monday.

item.title: UP govt tables supplementary budget amid sharp political sparring
item.description: Uttar Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Keshav Prasad Maurya on Monday defended the state government’s move to present a supplementary budget, asserting that the additional financial allocation is crucial to accelerating development across the state.
